text:
Vera (Partnerships): Quick sync — Cloud partner offered a co-funded private offer model. thinking: shorter commit + hardware credit + SI integration discount, and a joint announcement. want opinions on risks & renewal friction.
Mike (Sales): Love co-fund. do we have precedent on combining commit discounts + third-party credits?
Suresh (Finance): We do but need clear recognition rules. if partner pays credits, revenue still counted to us unless partner reimburses. need contract language.
Jordan (Legal): +1. also watch marketplace private offer constraints — some marketplaces require the commit shown on the offer UI. need explicit pass-through wording for credits and a cap.
Anya (Product): From product POV, we can support a promo code flow for SI credits, but marketplace private offers are rigid. any promo needs a post-sale redemption linked to customer id.
Vera (Partnerships): here's a rough structure: 12-month commit at 30% off list, partner contributes $Xk in GPU credits up front, SI gets a one-time 10% invoice credit for integration. renewal option: auto-renew at baseline list price unless customer opts into new private offer.
Mike (Sales): Customers already hate auto-renew surprises. we should offer a simple renewal play: 60 days before term end we send renewal options (1) renew commit (2) convert to paygo + partner credits burn down.
Liz (Marketing): Joint announcement okay but need partner sign-off on messaging re: discounts. timeline depends on legal approvals.
Suresh (Finance): A few flags: partner credits should be recorded as contra-revenue or vendor credit. also need reconciliation cadence (monthly) so we don't misstate usage.
Jordan (Legal): I'll draft a clause for partner credit mechanics and an audit right. also propose an explicit renewal notice timeline and a termination-for-convenience cap.
Anya (Product): Operationally, we need two things: 1) private-offer ID mapped to partner contribution in billing, 2) SI credit applied as separate billing line so accounting can reconcile.
Vera (Partnerships): Good. what's a conservative discount stack that keeps unit economics healthy?
Suresh (Finance): If our baseline gross margin target is 60%, then combined discount (marketplace + partner + SI credit) should be <= 25% in most cases. partner credits reduce cash exposure but not our gross margin unless reimbursed.
Mike (Sales): For larger enterprise deals we can flex to 35% combined if we get 2-3 year term and higher commit.
Vera (Partnerships): Thoughts on announcement cadence? partner wants joint blog + marketplace featured tile.
Liz (Marketing): We can do a soft co-marketing push at launch and full case study after first 3 customers close. need partner assets + logo/boilerplate from legal.
Jordan (Legal): I'll send logo/brand use terms. add a clause that we can reference aggregate savings but not specific pricing per customer.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace private offer must be submitted by vendor admin and take 3-5 business days for approval.
Vera (Partnerships): action items: Jordan drafts partner-credit + renewal clauses, Suresh gives recommended accounting treatment and ceiling %, Anya creates billing mapping doc, Mike to draft renewal cadence email, Liz to request partner marketing assets. I'll coordinate partner call Fri.
Mike (Sales): I'll prep a sample renewal email + 60/30/14 day cadence.
Suresh (Finance): sending the accounting note by EOD tomorrow.
Jordan (Legal): I'll share template language by tomorrow afternoon.
Anya (Product): Creating billing mapping ticket, ETA Wed.
Liz (Marketing): I'll ping partner for assets and draft launch plan after legal has logo ok. :+1:
Vera (Partnerships): Thanks all. if anyone wants to add negotiation leverage: ask partner for a small onboarding rebate tied to volume milestones (helps our cash flow).
Mike (Sales): Good call. I can negotiate milestones: 3 buckets (>$250k, >$750k, >$2M) with incremental partner rebate.
Vera (Partnerships): Perfect — will include in agenda.
Jordan (Legal): Also adding auditing window: 24 months post-term for partner credit reconciliation.
Vera (Partnerships): last: please react in-thread when you finish your item so I can close the loop. :sparkles:
